admittedFamily.legacyExclusionReason: Legacy v1-v3 branches do not emit the queue admission lease and must not inherit an unsatisfiable required context.

rulesetActivation.rulesetName: Buildchain dev merge queue: admitted default dev channel
rulesetActivation.providerConstraint: GitHub merge queue rulesets reject wildcard ref targets. The repository default branch is the moving authority pointer, and resolveDevBranch admits it only when it belongs to the v4+ dev family.

reviewAuthority.reason: GitHub evaluates the most recent reviewable push. A tree-identical empty commit does not transfer that push boundary or make the prior pusher eligible to approve it.

rulesetActivation.reason: The pull-request lease is a user-authored commit status while the merge-group continuation is a GitHub Actions check.

threatBoundary: Prevents inadvertent direct queue admission and stale-controller continuation. The named status alone is insufficient: merge-group continuation reads the exact Buildchain state-ref revision, active Warrant, fencing token, generation and source head, while affected-native records the exact Integration Delivery Proof before protected merge observation.
